nm:output.nm:control_stream:
$PROB IV2 DATA, 2COMP IV BOLUS P:140iv2 F:BASE $INPUT ID TIME AMT DV MDV EVID WT SEX $DATA ../../data/iv2-sim.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBR ADVAN3 TRANS4 $ABBR DERIV2=NO
$PK CL = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1)) V1 = THETA(2) * EXP(ETA(2)) Q = THETA(3) * EXP(ETA(3)) V2 = THETA(4) * EXP(ETA(4)) S1 = V1
$ERROR IPRE = F W = 1 W = SQRT(THETA(5)**2 + THETA(6)**2 * IPRE**2) IF (W.LT.1E-6) W = 1E-6 IRES = DV - IPRE IWRE = IRES / W Y = IPRE + W * EPS(1)
$THETA (0, 5) ; CL (L/h) (0, 20) ; V1 (L) (0, 8) ; Q (L/h) (0, 60) ; V2 (L) (0, 0.02) ; additive error SD (mg/L) (0, 0.1) ; proportional error CV
$OMEGA 0.1 ; CL 0.1 ; V1 0.1 ; Q 0.1 ; V2
$SIGMA 1 FIX
$EST MAX=9999 PRINT=5 METHOD=COND INTER NSIG=3 SIGL=9 NOABORT NOTBT NOOBT NOSBT $COV UNCOND PRINT=E $TAB ID TIME AMT DV MDV EVID CL V1 Q V2 IPRE IWRE CWRES ONEHEADER NOPRINT FILE=sdtab $TAB ID CL V1 Q V2 ETA1 ETA2 ETA3 ETA4 ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=patab $TAB ID WT ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=cotab $TAB ID SEX ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=catab
